title: Head CT resources with hemorrhage- or fracture-related references: access, license and use in this study (checked 26–29 October 2026)

notes: Open: obtainable without an account, application, approval, credentialing or a signed data use agreement, by anonymous download or after accepting click-through terms, under a license permitting research use, from the creators or from mirrors carrying their license. Of the 27 resources (28 entries; the current and earlier releases of CT-ICH are listed separately), 11 were open, 2 required a free account, 4 a signed data use agreement or an application, 3 were available only on request, 1 had been announced but not released, 5 were not released, located, reachable or verified, and 1 consisted of third-party re-uploads that add no new reference. Releases no longer available from their original host and unauthorized re-uploads were not counted (several Kaggle copies of the restricted CT-ICH release were found and are not listed). License tags are given as displayed by the hosting repository; BHSD and the MBH-Seg 2025 releases re-host images derived from the RSNA 2019 challenge, whose terms restrict redistribution, and Seg-CQ500 re-hosts CQ500 images, whose license is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Releases were counted when their creators provided new reference annotations; public Kaggle datasets can be downloaded without an account through Kaggle’s public interface. About 1,600 listings were screened and about 110 records examined in full; sources and queries are described in Methods. FITBIR, Federal Interagency Traumatic Brain Injury Research informatics system; ICH, intracranial hemorrhage; IPH, intraparenchymal hemorrhage; IVH, intraventricular hemorrhage; MIRA, Medical Imaging Resource for AI; RSNA, Radiological Society of North America; SAH, subarachnoid hemorrhage.
